decisions.statement: The task capture reaches this module as text rather than as a path.
A completion whose value is not a number is left out.
A key with a colon at or after its thirty-seventh character is no whole-task completion.
A key naming one character is carried out as a mark rather than dropped.
The keys left out are counted beside the completions captured.
A progress snapshot the game holds at zero is no progress.
A progress snapshot naming the whole task rather than one character is left out.
No Lua is run to read the capture.

definition: the task capture read into whole-task completions and per-character marks
